# Security test suite

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:security-tests` · **Epic:** [#122](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/122) · **Tickets:** 7 (7M)

Adds an in-process security suite under test/security that attacks the identity, token exchange, worker mTLS, enrollment and signed-bundle paths of the real CP and worker code with known-bad inputs. Every case asserts the exact rejection reason, that nothing reaches the upstream, and that no token or swapped secret leaks; a positive control in each category proves the harness is not rejecting everything. The suite runs in the default scripts/check.sh test stage, so a regression in any of these controls fails every PR.

## How we build it

- Location and gating: new package test/security as ordinary Go tests with no build tag, so `go vet ./...`, golangci-lint and the existing `go test -race -coverprofile ./...` stage in scripts/check.sh all compile and run it with no new flag. The suite is hermetic: loopback only, 127.0.0.1:0 ports, t.TempDir state, no Docker and no outside network. Budget: the whole package finishes in under 60s with -race on the CI runner. .github/workflows/ci.yml only calls scripts/check.sh, so no workflow change is needed.
- Real code paths only. Workers start through `worker.Run(ctx, out, worker.Params)` from a generated YAML config, and the CP starts through a new `controlplane.Run(ctx, out, controlplane.RunParams)` that W-P2-SECT-05 extracts from runControlPlane in cmd/proxy/controlplane.go, so the harness and `warden control-plane` build the same server, TLS config (MintServerTLS plus ClientAuth=RequestClientCert from W-P2-WCA-04), token service, keys, worker CA, bundle signer, BlockStore and agent registry. No identity, mTLS, bundle or block check is re-implemented in test code.
- Test seams (W-P2-SECT-05, Go-only): `worker.Params.TestHooks *worker.TestHooks{UpstreamDial, UpstreamRootCAs, OnReady}` and `controlplane.RunParams.OnReady` report bound addresses and let a loopback upstream fake be reached. proxy.New keeps NewSafeDialer for every real deployment: the hook is a Go struct field that no YAML key or flag can set, and a cmd/proxy test proves it is nil in the shipped binary.
- Shared fakes in test/fakes (non-test files, keys generated at runtime, nothing committed, no import of internal/controlplane): `fakes.OIDCIssuer` promoted from the W-P1-VRFY-05 helper in test/integration (discovery, JWKS, token endpoint, claim, header, alg and key overrides, key rotation, Stop for issuer-down cases); `fakes.AgentKey` (Ed25519 or ES256 JWK and private_key_jwt assertion builder); `fakes.TestCA` (foreign CA, expired, wrong-EKU and multi-SAN leaves); `fakes.Upstream` (TLS server counting requests and recording headers and body); `fakes.TamperProxy` (sits between worker and CP on /policy and can replay, mutate or replace envelopes). The P1 SSO tests and P3 consent tests reuse OIDCIssuer.
- Topology: one CP with tokenService, keys, workerCA, `--bundles=require`, `--require-worker-certs` and console OIDC login against fakes.OIDCIssuer; two workers pinned with `central.agentID` (agent-a and agent-b, W-P2-AREG-05), each enrolled with a `wet_` token, pinning `controlPlane.bundleKeys`, with `controlPlane.longPollWait: 2s` and observability metrics on. `tokenService.rateLimit` is raised for the matrix; one case uses the default. Each test category starts with a positive control: a valid user and agent request gets 200 through CONNECT, terminated HTTP/1.1 and MCP, the upstream sees exactly one hit carrying the swapped secret, and the bundle seq gauge is above 0. Attack subtests run only after it passes.
- One case matrix: `Case{Name, Path(worker|token|cp-route|enroll|bundle), Attack, WantStatus, WantResult, WantReason, WantAudit, WantUpstreamHits}`. Assertion sources: the HTTP response (OAuth error, 407 with Proxy-Authenticate on CONNECT, 403 `identity_required` on terminated traffic (never 401, W-P2-WBND-03), 403 `user_blocked` or `agent_disabled`, plain JSON 403 on MCP); the worker deny event Reason from its SQLite store; the worker admin /metrics scrape (`warden_identity_verify_total{result,reason}`, the P1 instrument extended in P2, and `warden_bundle_rejected_total{reason}`); and on the CP, which has no metrics endpoint until W-P5-RETN-06, the admin audit row (`worker.revoked`, `worker.cert_lineage_conflict`), the cpstate `token_events` row (token denials are not admin-audited, W-P2-TOKX-04) or the captured rate-limited rejection log line with its reason.
- Enum completeness: a test fails if any `identity.Reason` value, any `bundle.Reason` value, any token-service denial reason or any worker-facing CP route (/policy, /control/heartbeat, /central/ingest, /control/enroll, /control/renew, /oauth2/token) has neither a matrix case nor an entry in `test/security/pending.go` naming the ticket that will add it. Later tickets remove their entries; the feature is done when the list is empty, so a new reason or route without a test breaks the build.
- Leak invariant: the harness plants a canary swapped secret and a canary valid Warden token. After every case it checks that the token, every client assertion, subject_token, enrollment token and private key PEM never appear in the agent-visible response, the upstream request, CP or worker logs, admin audit rows, deny events or the /metrics scrape; that the swapped secret appears only in upstream requests of allowed cases; and that Proxy-Authorization and X-Warden-Identity never reach the upstream. Failure messages print kid and claim names only, never token strings.
- Token attacks (worker and /oauth2/token): alg none; HS256 keyed with the CP public JWK bytes or the issuer RSA public PEM; a foreign key under a real kid; unknown kid; embedded jwk, jku or x5u header (ignored, so verification uses only bundle or JWKS keys); unknown crit; JWE-shaped 5-segment token; over 16 KiB; wrong iss or aud; missing exp; exp-iat over the TTL; expired and nbf-future at `identity.clockSkewSeconds` plus and minus 5s; missing act.sub or cnf. Type confusion: a raw Dex ID token in require mode (rejected whether `identity.acceptDexTokens` is true or false, attribution only in attribute mode); a console-audience token at the worker and as subject_token; a Warden token (aud warden-worker) as subject_token. Client assertions: replayed jti, wrong aud, exp over 5m, iss != sub, agent-b key claiming agent-a.
- Issued-token lifetime: each case mints a valid token, warms the P1 verify cache (sha256(token) LRU) with one allowed request, then disables the agent, blocks the user through POST /dashboard/api/blocked-users, rotates the agent registry key out, or emergency-rotates the token key through POST /dashboard/api/keys/rotate. The next request must be denied within 3s (longPollWait 2s, and BlockStore and key changes wake the long-poll at once), and a CONNECT tunnel opened before the change is closed (W-P1-BLOCK-05). A stolen token replayed on the same agent's port is a documented known gap (no proof of possession in P2), kept as a skipped test.
- Transport and bundles: on /policy, /control/heartbeat and /central/ingest, no cert, revoked, foreign-CA, expired, wrong-EKU and multi-SAN client certs get 401, and a `wwt_` token gets 401 in strict-certs mode; the worker refuses a CP server cert outside its `controlPlane.caCert`. Through TamperProxy each `bundle.Reason` (malformed, too_large, unsupported_format, unsigned including the legacy wire to a pinned worker, unknown_kid including an envelope signed with the token key, bad_signature, issuer_mismatch, credential_mismatch, rollback, equivocation, expired, future) leaves the worker on last-known-good with the same seq gauge and the same decisions. Rollback and future cases are signed with the pinned test key through `bundle.Sign`, so they reach the seq and time checks.
- CP route boundaries and enrollment: a worker cert or `wwt_` token on /central/secrets and /dashboard/api/* never authenticates; a `wak_` API key on /policy and /oauth2/token is rejected; a console session cookie on /policy is ignored. /control/enroll rejects reused, expired and revoked `wet_` tokens with one identical 401 body, ignores CSR SANs (exactly one SPIFFE URI SAN), rejects RSA CSRs with 400; /control/renew rejects revoked certs and same-SPKI CSRs, and a renew from a superseded serial revokes the worker with `worker.cert_lineage_conflict`.
- Degraded and restart modes: CP down mid-run keeps require-mode enforcement with the last-known-good JWKS, block list and disabled-agent state; a worker restarted with the CP down loads its `controlPlane.bundleCacheDir` cache only after re-verifying it, and fails closed (deny all) on a tampered or too-old cache; a CP restart on the same state dir still rejects a replayed assertion jti and a used enrollment token; with the OIDC issuer stopped, exchange fails with no token minted and running workers keep serving valid Warden tokens.
- Go native fuzz targets in test/security for the worker token verifier and `bundle.Verify` (no success unless the input equals a validly signed seed); their seed corpora run inside normal `go test`, and longer fuzz runs are manual and outside CI.

## Done when

Plain `scripts/check.sh` runs test/security with no flag and no build tag on every PR and push to main, in under 60s with -race. Every matrix case is rejected with its expected status, result, reason and audit or log record, and reaches the upstream zero times, while each category's positive control reaches it once. test/security/pending.go is empty and the enum-completeness test passes. No canary token, assertion, enrollment token or key appears in responses, upstream requests, logs, audit rows, events or metrics. The PR for the last ticket records a drill showing the suite is not vacuous: disabling aud checking, cnf binding, cert revocation lookup and bundle signature verification, one at a time, each makes at least one case fail.

### 1/7 · W-P2-SECT-01

**Add security test harness with in-process CP, workers and shared fakes**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#123](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/123)

Create test/security with a harness that boots the real CP through controlplane.Run and two workers through worker.Run, plus shared fakes in test/fakes, so later tickets only add cases. The harness owns the positive controls, the case matrix runner, the leak invariant and the enum-completeness test, so no attack case can pass because the harness rejects everything or tests a copy of production code.

**Requirements**

- New package test/security with no build tag; it runs in the existing `go test -race -coverprofile ./...` stage of scripts/check.sh and is linted by golangci-lint with no config change. Loopback only, 127.0.0.1:0 ports, t.TempDir state, no Docker.
- Promote the W-P1-VRFY-05 in-process issuer from test/integration/oidc_issuer_test.go into a new non-test file test/fakes/oidcissuer.go as `fakes.OIDCIssuer` (Mint with claim, alg, kid, key and header overrides, RotateKey, Stop), and switch test/integration to it. Add new `fakes.AgentKey`, `fakes.TestCA` and `fakes.Upstream`. test/fakes must not import internal/controlplane or internal/identity, and no private key is committed.
- `StartStack(t, StackOptions)` runs controlplane.Run with tokenService, keys, workerCA, `--bundles=require`, `--require-worker-certs` and console OIDC login, then two workers with `central.agentID` agent-a and agent-b, `wet_` enrollment, pinned `controlPlane.bundleKeys`, `controlPlane.longPollWait: 2s`, metrics on and the upstream fake wired through worker.TestHooks. Readiness is awaited through OnReady and the bundle seq gauge, never sleeps.
- Observation helpers: `Metric(t, w, name, labels)` parses the worker admin /metrics scrape; `AuditRows(t, cp, action)` reads admin audit rows; `DenyEvents(t, w)` reads the worker event store; `Logs(t)` returns captured CP and worker log output.
- Case matrix runner `Run(t, []Case)` asserting status, result, reason, audit or log record and upstream hits per case, and `AssertNoLeak` after every case: no planted token, assertion, enrollment token or key PEM in responses, upstream requests, logs, audit rows, events or metrics; the swapped secret only in allowed upstream requests; Proxy-Authorization and X-Warden-Identity never at the upstream.
- Positive control `TestHarness_ValidFlow`: an admin registers agent-a, a user exchanges a fakes.OIDCIssuer ID token at POST /oauth2/token, and the Warden token gets 200 on CONNECT, terminated HTTP/1.1 and MCP with exactly one upstream hit each.
- Enum-completeness test over `identity.Reason`, `bundle.Reason`, token-service denial reasons and worker-facing CP routes, with a new test/security/pending.go listing every value not yet covered and the ticket key that will cover it.
- `TestCanary` is skipped unless the new test-only env var WARDEN_SECURITY_CANARY=1 is set, then fails, which proves the stage gates check.sh.

**Implementation plan**

1. Move the issuer helper into new test/fakes/oidcissuer.go as fakes.OIDCIssuer with MintOption helpers (WithAlg, WithKID, WithKey, WithHeader, WithClaims) and update test/integration/identity_test.go to use it.
2. Add new test/fakes/agentkey.go (fakes.AgentKey with JWK() and ClientAssertion(opts)), test/fakes/testca.go (fakes.TestCA) and test/fakes/upstream.go (fakes.Upstream with atomic hit counter and header and body recorder), with unit tests in test/fakes.
3. Add new test/security/harness.go with StartStack: write CP and worker YAML under t.TempDir, run controlplane.Run and worker.Run in goroutines with a shared log buffer, enroll workers with `wet_` tokens created through POST /dashboard/api/worker-enrollments, and wait on OnReady plus the `warden_bundle_seq` gauge.
4. Add new test/security/actors.go: AdminSession(t) (console OIDC login and X-Warden-CSRF), RegisterAgent(t, id, key, groups) through POST /dashboard/api/agents, Exchange(t, agentKey, idToken) against POST /oauth2/token, and Request(t, worker, token, transport) for CONNECT, terminated HTTP/1.1 and MCP.
5. Add new test/security/observe.go (Metric, AuditRows, DenyEvents, Logs) and new test/security/matrix.go (Case, Run, AssertNoLeak).
6. Add new test/security/harness_test.go with TestHarness_ValidFlow, TestHarness_Budget (stack ready in under 10s with -race), TestEnumCompleteness, TestNoLeakGuard (a planted token in a log line makes AssertNoLeak fail) and TestCanary, plus new test/security/pending.go and doc.go describing how to run the suite.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./test/security -run TestHarness_ValidFlow` passes: 200 on all three transports, exactly one upstream hit each, and `warden_identity_verify_total{result="valid"}` rises by 3.
- [ ] `WARDEN_SECURITY_CANARY=1 scripts/check.sh` exits non-zero with `FAIL` for test/security, and plain `scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] `go test ./test/security -run TestNoLeakGuard` passes, proving AssertNoLeak fails when a planted token appears in captured logs.
- [ ] `go test ./test/fakes` passes and shows OIDCIssuer can emit alg none, HS256 and an unknown kid, and that `identity.NewOIDCVerifier` accepts its valid tokens.
- [ ] `go test -tags=integration ./test/integration/...` still passes using fakes.OIDCIssuer, and `git grep -l 'BEGIN .*PRIVATE KEY' test/` returns nothing.

### 2/7 · W-P2-SECT-02

**Add token forgery, confusion and replay cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#124](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/124)

Add the worker and /oauth2/token matrices for forged, malformed, confused and replayed tokens and client assertions. Each case pins its expected status, result and reason, so a regression in alg, kid, iss, aud, lifetime or type checks fails the build. A raw Dex token must never pass require mode, and Warden, console and Dex tokens must each be rejected wherever they are not the expected type.

**Requirements**

- Worker matrix in require mode for agent-a over CONNECT (407 with `Proxy-Authenticate: Basic realm="warden"`), terminated HTTP/1.1 (403 `{"error":"identity_required",...}`, never 401) and MCP (plain JSON 403, no JSON-RPC body): alg none, HS256 keyed with the CP public JWK bytes, a foreign key under a real kid, unknown kid, embedded jwk/jku/x5u header, unknown crit, 5-segment JWE shape, over 16 KiB, wrong iss, wrong aud, missing exp, exp-iat over 15m, expired and nbf-future at `identity.clockSkewSeconds` plus 5s, a token signed by the bundle key.
- Boundary controls: tokens expired or not-yet-valid by `identity.clockSkewSeconds` minus 5s are accepted, so the leeway is tested from both sides with margins that -race slowness cannot flip.
- Type confusion: a valid raw Dex ID token is rejected in require mode with `identity.acceptDexTokens` true and false, and gives attribution only (allowed on policy, identity fields set) in attribute mode; a console-audience token is rejected at the worker; Proxy-Authorization and X-Warden-Identity carrying different valid subjects give result conflict and a deny in require mode.
- /oauth2/token matrix: subject_token forged (alg none, HS256 with the issuer RSA public PEM, wrong iss, wrong aud, expired), a Warden token or console token as subject_token, client_assertion with alg none, HS256, wrong key, unknown kid, iss != sub, aud other than the token URL, exp-iat over 5m, agent-b key claiming agent-a, and a reused jti. Each expects the RFC 6749 error (invalid_grant or invalid_client) and status 400 or 401.
- Every worker case asserts a +1 on `warden_identity_verify_total{result,reason}` with the pinned reason, a deny event with the same reason and zero upstream hits; every CP case whose assertion verified asserts one `token_events` row with outcome denied and the pinned W-P2-TOKX-04 reason (earlier failures assert the rate-limited WARN line and counter instead) and a response body carrying only the error and reason code.
- Rate limit: with the default `tokenService.rateLimit`, the 31st exchange in one minute for one user (default perUser 30/minute) gets 429 with Retry-After and a `token_events` row with reason rate_limited.
- Fuzz target FuzzWardenToken in test/security feeds mutated tokens to the worker verifier; its seed corpus (the matrix tokens) runs in normal go test, and no input other than an unmodified valid seed verifies.
- Remove the covered identity.Reason and token-service reason entries from test/security/pending.go.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add new test/security/forge.go with raw JWS helpers: header and claims JSON, base64url, signing with internal/keys signers, HMAC-SHA256 or none, and header injection.
2. Add new test/security/token_worker_test.go: positive control first, then the worker table run on all three transports for alg none and unknown kid and on CONNECT for the rest, through the matrix runner.
3. Add the Dex downgrade cases, restarting the stack with `identity.acceptDexTokens` true and false and with agent-a in attribute mode.
4. Add new test/security/token_exchange_test.go with the /oauth2/token table, including the replayed jti and the default rate-limit case on a separate stack.
5. Add new test/security/fuzz_token_test.go (FuzzWardenToken) with the forged tokens as seeds.
6. Remove covered entries from test/security/pending.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./test/security -run 'TestTokenWorker'` passes, and each case increments `warden_identity_verify_total` once with its pinned result and reason and leaves the upstream hit counter unchanged.
- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./test/security -run 'TestTokenExchange'` passes, and each case returns its pinned OAuth error and status and writes one `token_events` row (when the assertion verified) containing no token string.
- [ ] Given an accepted client assertion, when the same jti is resent within its TTL, then the CP returns 401 invalid_client and issues no token: `go test ./test/security -run TestTokenExchange/replayed_jti`.
- [ ] A valid Dex ID token in require mode is denied with reason unbound_token with acceptDexTokens true and false: `go test ./test/security -run TestTokenWorker/raw_dex`.
- [ ] `go test ./test/security -run FuzzWardenToken` runs the seed corpus and passes.

### 3/7 · W-P2-SECT-03

**Add binding, cross-agent and issued-token lifetime cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#125](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/125)

Add cases proving a valid token is bound to its agent and stops working when the agent, the user or the signing key is cut off, even while the 15-minute token is unexpired and its verify result is cached. This covers cnf and act.sub binding, an ambiguous worker agent id, group checks, the agent kill switch, the block list and emergency key rotation, each with a 3s deadline.

**Requirements**

- cnf mismatch: after agent-a's registry key is replaced through PUT /dashboard/api/agents/agent-a, a token minted with the old key is denied with reason cnf_mismatch once the worker's bundle seq advances, even though its verify result was cached.
- Cross-agent: agent-a's valid token on agent-b's worker is denied with reason agent_mismatch on CONNECT and terminated HTTP. A worker with no central.agentID and two configured agents (agent id `agent:<port>`, not registered) denies every token in require mode with agent_unregistered.
- Groups: a user whose groups do not intersect agent-a's allowed_groups gets unauthorized_client at POST /oauth2/token and a `token_events` row with reason group_not_allowed. A token issued before allowed_groups shrank stays valid on the worker until exp (the accepted gap stated in p2-worker-bound), and the case asserts that a new exchange is refused.
- Disabled agent: after POST /dashboard/api/agents/agent-a/disable, a new exchange gets invalid_client, and within 3s every request on agent-a's worker gets 403 `{"error":"agent_disabled"}` with deny event Reason agent_disabled, including requests with a valid token; a tunnel opened earlier is closed. agent-b keeps working.
- Block list: after POST /dashboard/api/blocked-users {sub}, within 3s the user's next request with a still-valid token gets 403 `{"error":"user_blocked"}`, the earlier tunnel is closed, a new exchange gets invalid_grant with reason user_blocked, and a second user is unaffected. The label is `user_blocked` everywhere.
- Key cut: after POST /dashboard/api/keys/rotate {purpose: token, emergency: true}, a cached-valid token signed by the old kid is denied with unknown_kid within 3s, and a token from the new key works.
- A skipped, documented `TestStolenTokenSamePort_KnownGap` records that a stolen token replayed on the same agent's port passes until exp in P2 (no proof of possession).
- Each denial asserts the reason metric, the event or audit row and zero upstream hits, and removes its entries from test/security/pending.go.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add new test/security/binding_test.go: positive control on both workers, then cross-agent and ambiguous-agent-id cases (the latter starts a third worker without central.agentID).
2. Add the cnf rotation case: warm the cache with one allowed request, PUT a new key with If-Match, wait for the `warden_bundle_seq` gauge to advance, then present the old token.
3. Add new test/security/lifetime_test.go with a helper that opens a CONNECT tunnel, warms the cache, applies a cut, and polls every 100ms up to 3s for denial and tunnel closure.
4. Apply the helper to agent disable, user block and emergency token-key rotation, checking that the other agent and the other user still get 200.
5. Add the group-mismatch exchange case and the asserted allowed_groups-shrink behaviour.
6. Add the skipped known-gap test and update test/security/pending.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] agent-a's token on agent-b's worker is denied with agent_mismatch and zero upstream hits: `go test -race ./test/security -run TestBinding/agent_mismatch`.
- [ ] A cached-valid token whose key was rotated out of the registry is denied with cnf_mismatch: `go test ./test/security -run TestBinding/cnf_rotated`.
- [ ] Given a user with an open tunnel and a valid token, when an admin blocks them, then within 3s their next request gets 403 user_blocked, the tunnel is closed and a second user still gets 200: `go test -race ./test/security -run TestLifetime/user_blocked`.
- [ ] After disable, every request on agent-a's worker gets 403 agent_disabled within 3s and a new exchange gets invalid_client: `go test ./test/security -run TestLifetime/agent_disabled`.
- [ ] After an emergency token-key rotation, a cached token with the old kid is denied with unknown_kid within 3s: `go test ./test/security -run TestLifetime/token_key_revoked`.

### 4/7 · W-P2-SECT-04

**Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#126](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/126)

Add cases proving only valid, unrevoked worker certs reach the worker-plane routes and that a pinned worker applies only bundles that pass every check. Malicious bundles are served through fakes.TamperProxy, so the worker's real RemoteProvider and bundle.Verify are under test. After every rejected bundle the worker must keep its last-known-good policy.

**Requirements**

- With `--require-worker-certs`, direct HTTPS clients on /policy, /control/heartbeat and /central/ingest get 401 for no cert, a foreign-CA cert, an expired cert (minted with a past NotAfter, no clock waits), a wrong-EKU cert, a multi-URI-SAN cert and a `wwt_` token; each matches a rate-limited CP log reason (bad_chain, expired, bad_eku, bad_san) and the positive control with an enrolled cert gets 200.
- Revocation: after POST /dashboard/api/workers/{id}/revoke, a held /policy long-poll returns 401 within 1s, the next request on the same keep-alive connection gets 401, a `worker.revoked` audit row exists, and the worker keeps enforcing its last-known-good policy.
- The worker refuses a CP server cert not chaining to its `controlPlane.caCert` (a stub CP using fakes.TestCA) and keeps its last-known-good policy.
- New fakes.TamperProxy between worker and CP serves one case per `bundle.Reason`: malformed, too_large, unsupported_format, unsigned (including the legacy policyWire to a pinned worker), unknown_kid (including an envelope signed with the token key), bad_signature (one flipped payload byte), issuer_mismatch, credential_mismatch, rollback (an older valid envelope replayed, including the pre-block one), equivocation, expired and future. Rollback, equivocation, expired and future are signed with the pinned test key through `bundle.Sign`.
- After each rejection `warden_bundle_rejected_total{reason}` rises by 1 with the matching reason, the next heartbeat carries lastRejectReason, the `warden_bundle_seq` gauge is unchanged, a host allowed only by the malicious bundle stays denied and a previously allowed host still gets 200.
- Fuzz target FuzzBundleVerify calls bundle.Verify on mutated valid envelopes (including duplicate JSON members and trailing data) and asserts no input other than an unmodified seed verifies; the seeds run in normal go test.
- Remove the covered bundle.Reason and route entries from test/security/pending.go.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add new test/security/workercert_test.go: positive control with the enrolled cert, then the cert table using fakes.TestCA leaves and a minted `wwt_` token, asserting 401 and the captured CP log reason.
2. Add the revocation case: hold a /policy long-poll and a keep-alive connection, call the revoke API with an admin session, and assert 401 timing, the audit row and unchanged worker decisions.
3. Add new test/fakes/tamperproxy.go (fakes.TamperProxy with Replay, Mutate and Replace hooks over /policy) and point a worker's controlPlane.url at it.
4. Add new test/security/bundle_test.go with one case per bundle.Reason, building validly signed hostile envelopes with bundle.Sign and the harness's pinned test signer.
5. After each case assert the metric delta, heartbeat lastRejectReason from the fleet API, the seq gauge and two probe requests.
6. Add new test/security/fuzz_bundle_test.go (FuzzBundleVerify) and update test/security/pending.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] After revoke, the worker's held long-poll returns 401 within 1s and its next heartbeat gets 401, with a `worker.revoked` row: `go test -race ./test/security -run TestWorkerCert/revoked`.
- [ ] No cert, foreign-CA, expired, wrong-EKU and multi-SAN certs each get 401 on /policy: `go test ./test/security -run 'TestWorkerCert/(no_cert|foreign_ca|expired|bad_eku|multi_san)'`.
- [ ] For every bundle.Reason, `warden_bundle_rejected_total` rises once with that reason, the seq gauge is unchanged and earlier allow and deny decisions hold: `go test -race ./test/security -run TestMaliciousBundle`.
- [ ] A pinned worker served the legacy unsigned wire rejects it with reason unsigned and keeps last-known-good: `go test ./test/security -run TestMaliciousBundle/legacy_downgrade`.
- [ ] `go test ./test/security -run FuzzBundleVerify` runs the seed corpus and passes.

### 5/7 · W-P2-SECT-05

**Add Go-only test seams for in-process CP and worker runs**

Type **chore** · Size **M** · Issue [#273](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/273)

The suite cannot prove anything today: proxy.New always installs NewSafeDialer, which blocks the loopback upstream fake, and the CP is assembled only inside runControlPlane in cmd/proxy, which tests cannot import. Add Go-only seams so test/security drives the same assembly as the shipped binary and can reach a loopback upstream, without any YAML key or flag that could weaken the SafeDialer in production.

**Requirements**

- New `worker.TestHooks{UpstreamDial func(ctx, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error); UpstreamRootCAs *x509.CertPool; OnReady func(proxyAddr, adminAddr string)}` and field `worker.Params.TestHooks *TestHooks` (nil by default). It is passed to new `proxy.Config` fields `TestUpstreamDial` and `TestUpstreamRootCAs`; when nil, proxy.New keeps `NewSafeDialer(10*time.Second, nil)` unchanged.
- No YAML key, env var or CLI flag can set the hooks. A new test in cmd/proxy asserts the worker command builds worker.Params with TestHooks == nil.
- Move the assembly in runControlPlane (cmd/proxy/controlplane.go) into new `controlplane.Run(ctx context.Context, out io.Writer, p RunParams) error` in new internal/controlplane/run.go, mirroring worker.Run; RunParams carries every value the cobra flags set today plus `OnReady func(addr string)`. cmd/proxy/controlplane.go becomes flag parsing plus one call.
- Behaviour is unchanged: existing cmd/proxy and internal/controlplane tests pass without edits, startup log lines and flag errors are byte-identical, and listening on port 0 reports the bound address through OnReady.
- The hooks are documented in the Go doc as test-only, and a startup WARN `test hooks active` is logged if any hook is set, so accidental use outside tests is visible.
- No secret, token or key appears in any new log line.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add new internal/worker/testhooks.go with TestHooks and thread Params.TestHooks into the proxy.Config built in worker.Run, calling OnReady after both listeners are bound.
2. Add the hook fields to proxy.Config and use them in proxy.New in place of the SafeDialer only when set; add a proxy unit test showing that with nil hooks a loopback dial is still blocked.
3. Add new internal/controlplane/run.go with RunParams and Run, moving the body of runControlPlane and binding the listener with net.Listen so OnReady gets the real address.
4. Reduce runControlPlane in cmd/proxy/controlplane.go to building RunParams from cpOptions and calling controlplane.Run.
5. Add new cmd/proxy/testhooks_test.go asserting TestHooks is nil for `warden run` and that no flag or config field references it.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `go test ./internal/proxy -run TestSafeDialerDefault` passes: with no hooks a CONNECT to 127.0.0.1 is still refused.
- [ ] `go test ./cmd/proxy -run TestNoTestHooksInBinary` passes.
- [ ] A test starting controlplane.Run on 127.0.0.1:0 receives the bound address through OnReady and gets 200 from /healthz: `go test ./internal/controlplane -run TestRunOnReady`.
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes with no change to existing tests, and `git grep -n TestHooks -- internal/config` returns nothing.

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WCA-04`](worker-mtls.md#48--w-p2-wca-04) Accept worker certs in WorkerAuthenticator and add /control/renew; [`W-P2-SBND-02`](signed-bundles.md#27--w-p2-sbnd-02) Serve the signed bundle envelope on GET /policy behind --bundles; [`W-P2-TOKX-03`](token-exchange.md#37--w-p2-tokx-03) Mount POST /oauth2/token with RFC 8693 request parsing and config; [`W-P2-KEYS-04`](key-management.md#47--w-p2-keys-04) Serve the token JWKS, readiness and admin key API from the control plane

### 6/7 · W-P2-SECT-06

**Add CP route-boundary and enrollment attack cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#274](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/274)

Add cases proving each credential works only on the CP routes meant for it, and that enrollment and renewal cannot mint certs for the wrong worker or revive a revoked one. Worker certs and `wwt_` tokens must never reach human-only routes, API keys must never act as worker or agent credentials, and a renewal must never change the worker id.

**Requirements**

- A valid worker cert or `wwt_` token on /central/secrets (every method) and /dashboard/api/* gets 401 or 403 and never data; a console session cookie on /policy and /control/heartbeat does not authenticate.
- A valid `wak_` API key (W-P2-APIK-02) on /policy, /control/heartbeat and /oauth2/token is rejected and never treated as a worker or agent credential.
- /control/enroll: a reused, expired or revoked `wet_` token gets 401 with a byte-identical body; a CSR requesting extra SANs, a CN or CA:true yields a cert with exactly one SPIFFE URI SAN for the token's worker id, EKU clientAuth only and IsCA false; an RSA CSR gets 400 without consuming the token; the 11th request in a minute from one address gets 429.
- /control/renew: a revoked cert gets 401 and no cert; a CSR with the current SPKI is rejected; a renew from a superseded serial outside the 10-minute window revokes the worker and writes a `worker.cert_lineage_conflict` row.
- No case returns or logs the enrollment token, its hash or the CSR, checked through AssertNoLeak.
- Remove the covered route entries from test/security/pending.go.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add new test/security/routes_test.go with a table of (credential, route, method, want status) covering worker cert, `wwt_`, `wak_` and console cookie, plus a positive control per credential on its own route.
2. Add new test/security/enroll_test.go creating `wet_` tokens through POST /dashboard/api/worker-enrollments and driving /control/enroll with crafted CSRs.
3. Parse issued certs and assert SANs, EKU, IsCA and the worker id from workerca.WorkerIDFromCert.
4. Add renew cases: revoke then renew, same-SPKI CSR, and a renew from the previous serial after the window, asserting the audit row.
5. Update test/security/pending.go.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `go test -race ./test/security -run TestRouteBoundary` passes, and no worker cert, `wwt_` or `wak_` credential gets a 2xx outside its own routes.
- [ ] A CSR asking for extra SANs yields a cert with exactly one SPIFFE URI SAN for the token's worker id: `go test ./test/security -run TestEnroll/csr_sans_ignored`.
- [ ] Reused, expired and revoked enrollment tokens get byte-identical 401 bodies: `go test ./test/security -run TestEnroll/bad_token`.
- [ ] A revoked worker's /control/renew gets 401 and issues no cert: `go test ./test/security -run TestRenew/revoked`.

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SECT-01`](security-tests.md#17--w-p2-sect-01) Add security test harness with in-process CP, workers and shared fakes; [`W-P2-WCA-05`](worker-mtls.md#58--w-p2-wca-05) Implement worker cert revocation in the console and CLI; [`W-P2-APIK-02`](api-keys.md#27--w-p2-apik-02) Authenticate API keys and enforce per-route scopes in the authz table; [`W-P1-SSO-06`](console-sso-rbac.md#68--w-p1-sso-06) Require an admin session on /central/secrets and flag open consoles

### 7/7 · W-P2-SECT-07

**Add degraded-mode and restart cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#275](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/275)

Add cases proving the security controls hold when parts of the system are down or restart: the CP, the OIDC issuer and the worker itself. Require mode must keep enforcing from last-known-good state, a tampered or stale bundle cache must make the worker fail closed, and replay protection must survive a CP restart.

**Requirements**

- CP down mid-run: with the CP stopped, require mode keeps accepting valid Warden tokens and rejecting forged ones, the blocked user stays blocked and the disabled agent stays disabled until tokens expire.
- Worker restart with the CP down and `controlPlane.bundleCacheDir` set: a valid cache is re-verified against the pins and enforced; a cache with one byte changed, or older than `controlPlane.bundleCacheMaxAge`, is refused and the worker denies all traffic. Without a cache the worker stays fail-closed as today.
- CP restart on the same state dir: a client assertion jti used before the restart is still rejected, a used `wet_` token still gets 401, and the block list and agent registry are unchanged.
- OIDC issuer down (fakes.OIDCIssuer.Stop with a new signing key not yet fetched): exchange fails with an OAuth error and no token minted, and running workers keep serving existing valid Warden tokens.
- Restarts reuse the same t.TempDir state dirs, and each case finishes in under 10s with -race.
- After this ticket test/security/pending.go is empty, and the enum-completeness test runs with no pending entries.

**Implementation plan**

1. Add Stop and Restart helpers to test/security/harness.go that cancel the Run context and start again on the same state and config paths.
2. Add new test/security/degraded_test.go with the CP-down case using tokens minted before the stop.
3. Add the worker restart cases, tampering `<bundleCacheDir>/bundle.json` by one byte and rewriting its issuedAt past bundleCacheMaxAge through a re-signed test envelope.
4. Add the CP restart replay cases and the issuer-down exchange case.
5. Empty test/security/pending.go and make TestEnumCompleteness fail on any pending entry.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] With the CP stopped, a valid token still gets 200 and a forged one 407 on CONNECT: `go test -race ./test/security -run TestDegraded/cp_down`.
- [ ] A worker restarted with the CP down and a one-byte-tampered bundle cache denies all traffic: `go test ./test/security -run TestDegraded/tampered_cache`.
- [ ] A jti used before a CP restart is rejected with invalid_client after it: `go test ./test/security -run TestDegraded/cp_restart_replay`.
- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./test/security` passes in under 60s with test/security/pending.go empty.

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SECT-02`](security-tests.md#27--w-p2-sect-02) Add token forgery, confusion and replay cases; [`W-P2-SECT-03`](security-tests.md#37--w-p2-sect-03) Add binding, cross-agent and issued-token lifetime cases; [`W-P2-SECT-04`](security-tests.md#47--w-p2-sect-04) Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases; [`W-P2-SECT-06`](security-tests.md#67--w-p2-sect-06) Add CP route-boundary and enrollment attack cases; [`W-P2-SBND-06`](signed-bundles.md#67--w-p2-sbnd-06) Add an opt-in last-known-good bundle cache for worker restarts
